title: Social Mobility
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
What does social mobility look like in real life, not just in statistics?
Is education still the main route to moving upward economically?
How much does family background affect opportunities even when laws treat everyone equally?
Should universities or employers actively consider disadvantaged backgrounds when selecting people?
What would make a society feel genuinely mobile rather than simply unequal with a few success stories?
